en: Abandon sealed commands that never reported a result instead of answering in_progress forever, confirm cancellation only after the execution environment is stopped, and publish SessionRunner terminal results after the route settles.
zh-CN: 对始终未上报结果的 sealed 命令给出可审计的终止状态而非永久 in_progress；仅在执行环境确认停止后才确认取消；SessionRunner 的终态结果改为路由结算后发布。
